$comment: THE CONVERGENCE MANIFEST — which lanes deliberately contain more than one programme.
Several lane-isolation guards assert that another programme's code is ABSENT from the branch.
Those guards are correct on a single-programme lane: they stop programme A quietly implementing
programme B's surface. On a lane whose declared purpose is to CONVERGE two parents, the same
assertion is false by construction — the other programme's code is present because it is
Rather than delete such a guard (which removes the protection everywhere) or leave it
permanently red (which teaches people to ignore a required check), a convergence lane DECLARES
itself here. A guard consults this file, and on a declared lane it inverts to the STRONGER
property: both parents are present AND neither has reached into the other's authority.
This file is the audit trail. Adding an entry is a visible, reviewable act in a pull request —
which is exactly what silencing a guard in place is not.

lanes.why: GMO depends on capabilities living in two separate Draft lanes: Service Network Foundation 1.0 (#197) supplies the garage workspace, and O2 People & Compliance (#208) supplies governed identity and the Operations reviewer machinery. Neither parent alone can carry the onboarding journey, so this lane converges both. Neither parent PR was modified.
